title: Genesis' two lights matched to the cosmic microwave background

tellings.quote: light returned to the universe and that's the light of the second day.

plain: The opening of the Book of Genesis, the story goes, describes two separate lights, and the second one matches the faint leftover glow of the early universe that astronomers call the cosmic microwave background. Greg Rogers, a former NASA doctor, offers this as his own reading, saying the moment "light returned to the universe" is "the light of the second day." If it holds, it would mean the ancient text echoes modern cosmology.
